items.title: Ypsilanti Township Officials Blast U-M Plan for $1.2B Data Center
items.dek: Township leaders in the lower-income community say they learned of the Textile Road site by text and plan to fight the project over location, transparency and job promises.

items.title: Michigan City Council Advances Ordinance for Indefinite Moratorium on New Hyperscale Data Centers
items.dek: Council members introduced the measure to allow time for updated regulations on environmental impacts, noise and development standards before any additional projects beyond the existing Google facility.
items.judge_note: Council introduction of an indefinite moratorium ordinance is a concrete legislative step, different from Zeeland's already-approved one-year moratorium.
